label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: No skip link. The first Tab stops were an unlabeled Close button in a popup and an Open chat button, and about 8 more Tab presses were needed to reach the main menu.

Reaching the first product took about 25 Tab presses because the header, icon links and 14 filter and sort buttons come first, with no way to skip to results. Each product card also adds Tab stops for colour swatches.
The product link is named only by its discount badge text, not by the product name, so I could not tell which product I was opening. Icon-only header links and buttons have no name either.

Before the options and Add to cart there were about 25 Tab stops: several unlabeled videos, many unlabeled links (gallery thumbnails) and many unlabeled buttons (fabric and leg swatches). I could not tell what they were or which option was chosen, and I ran out of steps before reaching Add to cart.
Option groups such as Fabric, Leather and Velvet are plain links, not a radio group or tabs, and swatch buttons give no name or selected state. Add to cart sits at the very end of a long tab order.
